rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: Dovish Fed (Warsh eased inflation fears) + cooler June jobs (57K vs 113K est) sparked a risk-on relief rally off 20-month lows; ETH leading the crypto bounce (~+9% on the day) from Extreme Fear (F&G 11).
positions.driver: Spot ETH is the momentum leader of a dovish-Fed risk-on bounce and trades continuously through the Jul 3 holiday + weekend (equity market closed), avoiding leveraged-ETF decay and Monday gap-through-stop risk on a multi-day hold.
positions.risks: Weekend risk-off reversal; record June ETF outflows ($4.5B) and cautious institutional sentiment overhang; ETH higher-beta so a broad crypto fade hits it harder than BTC. Spot (unleveraged) bounds the drawdown to ETH's own volatility.
